items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: We worked together at the Saratoga Club for quite a while.

ctx.x: Well, he was performing... We worked together at the Saratoga Club for quite a while. And he worked at different theatres, the Lafayette Theatre, in Washington and Philadelphia. He was around to different clubs and things. He was very popular. He was a good singer, too. A very good singer.
Was he sort of a regular with the Russell band, then, at that time?
